notes: Formula Retail Employee Rights Ordinances (FRERO) cover chains with 40+ formula retail establishments worldwide and 20+ employees in San Francisco.

Predictability pay for employer changes with <7 days' notice is 1 to 4 hours of pay depending on notice and shift length; encoded as change_premium_hours=1 (minimum) with extra key change_premium_hours_max=4. Exact tiers are in the OLSE FRERO Rules (not yet encoded).
On-call employees not called in are owed 2 to 4 hours of pay.
No SF rest-between-shifts rule recorded; California state meal/rest/OT rules apply.

rules.summary: Formula retail chains (40+ stores worldwide, 20+ SF employees) must post schedules two weeks ahead and pay 1-4 hours of predictability pay for changes with under 7 days' notice.

citation.title: San Francisco OLSE — Formula Retail Employee Rights Ordinance
citation.excerpt: Employers must provide employees with their schedules two weeks in advance ... a premium of 1 to 4 hours of pay

rules.summary: San Francisco's minimum wage is $19.61 an hour from July 1, 2026.
